attributes.affiliation_basis: Legion affiliation 'FRIEND' -> FRIENDLY; the source vocabulary is fifteen values wide and the CDM's is four, so the original is parked at attributes.legion_affiliation and the collapse is recoverable
attributes.entity_type_basis: Legion category 'SENSOR' -> SENSOR; the raw value is parked

export_review.basis: free-form vendor content that may describe our own estate rather than the world — the API's own example for `metadata` carries an ip_address, a manufacturer and a model. Parked in full because the never-drop rule is not negotiable, and flagged so a deployment reviews it before a CDM object crosses a releasability boundary. This adapter does not filter it

attributes.position_basis: crs ABSENT, so EPSG:4978 by the schema default; coordinates read as geocentric [X, Y, Z] metres and converted to geodetic on the WGS84 ellipsoid (a=6378137.0 m, 1/f=298.257223563) by the closed-form Bowring/Ferrari solution. The source coordinates are re-emitted verbatim at attributes.legion_position; this Position is a derived one-way view
attributes.position_source_basis: ESTIMATED. Legion's location `source` names the SYSTEM that produced the fix ('Synthetic Site Survey') and never the positioning method, so there is nothing to read a method from. ESTIMATED understates rather than overstates, which is the safe direction for this field
attributes.symbol_basis: derived from affiliation; Legion states no symbol

payload.event_type_basis: TRACK_UPDATE. A location document reports where something was at an instant, which is what that member means
payload.observed_at_basis: location recorded_at — when the source recorded the fix
payload.received_at_basis: the injected clock. Legion's created_at is when the PLATFORM stored the record, which is its receipt and not ours
payload.severity_basis: INFO. Legion states no severity on any resource, so this is the format's silence and not an assessment that nothing is wrong
